entities.name: Abu'l-Fadl Harawi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu'l-Fadl Harawi was a 10th-century astronomer who, along with al-Khujandi, studied under the patronage of the Buyid dynasty in Ray, Iran. The nisba "Harawi" suggests that he was originally from Herat, in ancient times also known as Haraiva.
